item.title: State Street’s Hung on Trump Accounts, Private Markets, Future of ETFs
item.description: State Street Investment Management CEO and President Yie-Hsin Hung joins Bloomberg's Katie Greifeld and Eric Balchunas for a special edition of ETF IQ live on stage at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth Conference in New York on November 26, 2026. Hung discusses the firm's role in Trump Accounts, the growth of ETF partnerships, bringing private-market strategies into ETFs and how State Street is thinking about the next generation of investors and retirement. (Source: Bloomberg)
